title: Portrait and Parish
author: O. M. Nakamura
blurb: Edmund Montrose, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
